title: LM API Interaction
summary: This module provides synchronous and asynchronous functions for interacting with Language Model APIs, primarily via LiteLLM, handling request formatting, caching, and retry logic.

nodes.label: LiteLLM Completion (Sync)
nodes.title: Synchronous LiteLLM Completion
nodes.description: Handles synchronous API calls to language models using LiteLLM, including caching and retry mechanisms. It can also manage streaming completions.

nodes.label: LiteLLM Completion (Async)
nodes.title: Asynchronous LiteLLM Completion
nodes.description: Manages asynchronous API calls to language models via LiteLLM, supporting caching, retries, and asynchronous streaming completions.

nodes.label: LiteLLM Responses (Sync)
nodes.title: Synchronous LiteLLM Responses
nodes.description: Facilitates synchronous API calls for LiteLLM's 'responses' endpoint, converting chat requests and applying caching and retry policies.

nodes.label: LiteLLM Responses (Async)
nodes.title: Asynchronous LiteLLM Responses
nodes.description: Enables asynchronous API calls for LiteLLM's 'responses' endpoint, handling request conversion, caching, and retry logic.

nodes.label: LiteLLM Text Completion (Sync)
nodes.title: Synchronous LiteLLM Text Completion
nodes.description: Performs synchronous text completion requests, extracting model and provider details, constructing prompts, and applying API keys and bases.

nodes.label: LiteLLM Text Completion (Async)
nodes.title: Asynchronous LiteLLM Text Completion
nodes.description: Executes asynchronous text completion requests, parsing model information, building prompts, and managing API credentials.

nodes.label: Format for OpenAI Responses API
nodes.title: Convert to OpenAI Responses API Format
nodes.description: Transforms a normalized DSPy language model request into the specific format required by the OpenAI Responses API, including tool choices and messages.

nodes.label: Format for OpenAI Text API
nodes.title: Convert to OpenAI Text Completion Format
nodes.description: Converts a normalized DSPy language model request into the format expected by the OpenAI text completion API, handling model and prompt construction.

nodes.label: Async Stream Completion Wrapper
nodes.title: Asynchronous Stream Completion Wrapper
nodes.description: A wrapper function designed to handle asynchronous streaming completions, ensuring proper execution within an async context.

nodes.label: Base LM Clients
nodes.title: Base Language Model Clients
nodes.description: Provides foundational interfaces and implementations for various language model providers, including local and cloud-based options.

nodes.label: Caching and Utilities
nodes.title: Caching and Utility Functions
nodes.description: Offers utilities for caching API responses, managing LiteLLM logging, and handling disk serialization and embedding computations.

nodes.label: LMRequest Data Type
nodes.title: Language Model Request Data Type
nodes.description: Represents the standardized data structure for language model requests within DSPy, defining parameters like model, messages, and configuration.

groups.label: Synchronous API Calls
groups.title: Synchronous Language Model API Calls
groups.description: Functions for making blocking, synchronous requests to various language model APIs, handling immediate responses.

groups.label: Asynchronous API Calls
groups.title: Asynchronous Language Model API Calls
groups.description: Functions for making non-blocking, asynchronous requests to language model APIs, enabling concurrent operations and streaming.

groups.label: Request Formatting
groups.title: Language Model Request Formatting
groups.description: Utilities for converting internal DSPy language model requests into the specific formats required by external API providers like OpenAI.
